title: CLO Tips Mini Class - Applying Custom Display Settings
description: CLO 2025.0 Version Officially Launched! CLO Technical Experts Guide You Step-by-Step on How to Save Custom Display Settings!
transcript:
Open the display settings in 2025.0  
In version 2025.0, the display settings function has been added, so the software will no longer record previous display option changes.  
How to preserve the default display settings?  
When we open the file, the 3D window will randomly display the texture surface, as well as the basic line, internal line, thickness, and other information.  
First, in the 3D window, change the texture surface to the thick texture surface display.  
Then hide the internal line and the basic line.  
Also hide the thickness and thinness.  
In addition to the display settings in the 3D window, you can also change the display settings in the 2D window.  
You can choose to display or hide clothing information, version information, etc.  
For example, display or hide the version name and logo.  
You can also change the different clothing rendering types.  
After completing the settings, select the virtual model and delete it.  
Select all the panels and delete them.  
Save this blank file.  
After saving, go to the software settings and define the user name.  
Select default file, project, project file.  
Change the default file to the file you just saved.  
The 3D window will prompt you to restart the program for the changes to take effect.  
Restart the software to check the settings.  
Open any clothing and assign a virtual model.  
You will see that the display of this file is set to the settings you just saved.  
Press the Go button to start the program.  
The program will now start loading.

chunks.content: # CLO Tips Mini Class - Applying Custom Display Settings This document explains how to configure and preserve custom display settings in CLO version 2025.0, covering both 3D and 2D window display options, saving these settings as defaults, and applying them to new projects. --- ## Introduction to Display Settings in CLO 2025.0 This section covers the new display settings feature introduced in CLO version 2025.0, including how display option changes are managed and the importance of preserving default display preferences. - In CLO 2025.0, a display settings function was added. - The software no longer records previous display option changes automatically. - Users must manually configure and save display settings to preserve defaults. --- ## Configuring 3D Window Display Settings This section details the steps to customize display options in the 3D window, including texture surface types and visibility of garment details. - Upon opening a file, the 3D window may randomly display different textures and lines, including texture surface, basic lines, internal lines, thickness, and thinness. - To customize: - Change the texture surface display to **Thick Texture Surface**. - Hide **Internal Lines**. - Hide **Basic Lines**. - Hide **Thickness** and **Thinness** indicators. --- ## Configuring 2D Window Display Settings This section explains how to modify display settings in the 2D window, focusing on garment information and rendering options. - Available options include displaying or hiding: - Clothing information. - Version information (e.g., version name and logo). - Users can also change clothing rendering types to suit their preferences. --- ## Saving Custom Display Settings as Defaults This section describes the procedure to save your customized display settings so they apply automatically to new projects. 1. After adjusting the display settings in the 3D and 2D windows: - Select the virtual model in the scene and delete it. - Select all garment panels and delete them. 2. Save the file as a **blank file** with your display preferences. 3. Go to the software **Settings** menu. 4. Define your **User Name**. 5. Under **Default File** or **Project File**, set the default to the blank file you just saved. 6. The software will prompt you to **restart the program** for changes to take effect. 7. Restart CLO. --- ## Applying Saved Display Settings to New Projects This section explains how to verify and use the saved default display settings when starting new projects. - After restarting, open any clothing file. - Assign a virtual model. - The 3D and 2D windows will display according to the custom settings saved in the default file. - Press the **Go** button to start the program; it will load with your preferred display setup. --- # Summary In CLO 2025.0, custom display settings for both 3D and 2D windows—including texture surfaces, line visibility, and clothing information—can be saved in a blank file and set as the default. This workflow ensures consistent display preferences across sessions and new projects, improving efficiency and user experience.
